description: On-demand PDF report of a French company: a shareable due-diligence dossier (formatted KYB file: identity, officers, legal alerts, financials, sanctions screening; includes the AI health summary when cached). Every page footer carries a public verification link (/verifier/ and the response's verification number) that whoever receives the PDF can open. Returns the PDF as base64. A SIREN whose administrative status or legal category is missing in Sirene is refused: 404 identite_incomplete (body: siren, champs_absents, fiche), never charged. Paid via x402 ($0.50 in USDC or EURC).

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) to pay with prepaid credits instead of x402, with no wallet needed. Get one at https://api.sirenic.eu/compte?utm_source=api&utm_campaign=mcp. Ignored when x_payment is provided (the signed payment wins). On insufficient balance the tool returns a credits error, not an x402 quote.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive the payment quote.

name: get_french_company_pdf_report
title: French company PDF report
